full_script: [happy] Falta una palabra en cada frase. ¿Cuál es? Dila rápido. Come into the kitchen. Get out of my car! Walk across the bridge. Ahora, nivel intermedio. The cat jumped onto the table. We walked along the river. The train went through a tunnel. He ran up the stairs. Y ahora, nivel experto. She walked past me without saying hi. The plane flew above the clouds. Keep away from the edge! Tres aciertos, nivel básico. Siete, intermedio. Diez, experto de verdad. [excited] ¿Llegaste a la diez? Te leo en los comentarios.
